title: Technical Sales & Applications Program (TSAP) – Technical Sales Engineer, Entry Level
description:
NXP Introduction

AI is rapidly moving beyond research labs and into the real world—powering advancements in vehicles, factories, hospitals, homes, and everyday devices. NXP’s Global Sales organization is the force that transforms our intelligent edge vision into meaningful market impact. We operate on the front lines of innovation, delivering real‑world AI, secure edge intelligence, and breakthrough technologies to the customers shaping tomorrow’s world. As a strategic partner at the intersection of customer ambition and NXP capability, our global sales team drives alignment, opens new markets, and builds the relationships that lead to design wins and revenue growth. Through deep market insight and long‑term collaboration, we embed customer‑centricity into every decision and help accelerate innovation at the system‑solution level. This disciplined, client‑first mindset enables us to architect integrated, future‑ready solutions that deliver sustained value and strengthen NXP’s competitive advantage. We thrive in a high‑performance, high‑ownership environment—competing boldly, executing with urgency, and celebrating results. If you want to win big, grow fast, and work with the customers building what’s next, NXP Global Sales is where ambition becomes achievement. For more information, please visit our website https://www.nxp.com

Program Overview

The Technical Sales & Applications Program (TSAP) is NXP’s early-career development program for new college graduates pursuing customer-facing technical roles within NXP’s Global Sales organization, with a focus on driving success in the Industrial, IoT, and Automotive markets. Designed for candidates who combine a strong technical foundation with the competitiveness and drive to succeed, TSAP prepares participants for a long-term career as Technical Sales Engineers (TSEs) through a combination of structured learning and on-the-job experience.

Program Structure

Integrated Learning & On-the-Job Development (9–12 Months)

Structured Learning includes semiconductor and system fundamentals; NXP product portfolios; embedded systems and software fundamentals; business fundamentals; and instructor-led training from NXP subject-matter experts and leaders.

On-the-Job Training includes territory or customer assignments including participating in customer meetings, technical reviews, assisting with evaluations and demos, and progressively taking ownership of technical responsibilities.

Career Outcomes

Upon completion, participants transition into a permanent TSE role within the Americas Sales organization, with placement based on business needs and candidate preferences.

The TSE is our field leader for the extended NXP team - the captain of our team. All of our business and technical strategies, customer communications (to/from), and overall actions, results with the customer are led and owned by the TSE role. As such, the TSE position requires people who aspire to be leaders for the organization.

You will have complete ownership of NXP’s relationship for a set of focused accounts or territory where you will be responsible for supporting these customers in their technical and business objectives.

Your goals will be focused on identifying new projects and crafting new solutions using NXP products to solve the customers challenges. You will be responsible for building trustworthy relationships with your customers by offering real-time business and technical support to their needs. Real time support and offering value based solutions to customer problems will ultimately lead you to contributing to our collective goal of growing NXP’s revenue within these accounts/regions.

Key Responsibilities

Support customers and partners through evaluation, design, and deployment of NXP solutions
Translate customer requirements into system-level technical solutions
Collaborate with sales, applications, and product teams to drive design wins
Prepare technical presentations and demos
Lead customer engagements and internal reviews
Develop technical depth while maintaining a system-level perspective

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
Graduate in past 24 months or upcoming graduate
Minimum GPA of 3.0 or higher
Demonstrated technical aptitude
Strong interest in customer-facing roles
Competitive mindset with a passion to win
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
Willingness to relocate within the United States

Anticipated hire date: Q2 2027
